stories.title: RBA interest rates: governor Michele Bullock explains decision to lift cash rate to 4.85% – video
stories.summary: RBA governor Michele Bullock has explained the decision to raise the cash rate from 4.6% to 4.85%, the fifth increase of the year. The bank is seeking to curb surging inflation amid a global oil shock, while the rate is now at its highest since 2008 and will add pressure to more than 3.3 million mortgage-holding households.

links.headline: RBA interest rates: governor Michele Bullock explains decision to lift cash rate to 4.85% – video
links.excerpt: The Reserve Bank of Australia has hiked interest rates for the fifth time this year, from 4.6% to 4.85%, in a bid to regain control of surging inflation amid the ongoing global oil shock triggered by the war in the Middle East. The RBA’s cash rate has now reached its highest level since 2008. stories.title: Alan Jones on Trial: Alleged victim’s mother ‘trusted’ Jones | Week 11 – video
stories.summary: The mother of the youngest complainant in Alan Jones’s trial told the court that she had trusted Jones with her then-teenage son. She wept after being shown a note in which her son alleged that something happened at Jones’s Fitzroy Falls property, and prosecutors asked why she remained in contact after he reported the alleged indecent assault.

links.headline: Alan Jones on Trial: Alleged victim’s mother ‘trusted’ Jones
links.excerpt: The mother of the youngest complainant wept on the stand after being presented with a note written by her son alleging something happened at Alan Jones's property at Fitzroy Falls. As the prosecution questioned the mother, she told the court she had “trusted” Jones with her then teenage son. She was also asked why she stayed in contact with the broadcaster after her son told her about the alleged indecent assault. Guardian Australia’s media correspondent Amanda Meade</st
